Here’s a **selected list of Sherlock Holmes movies**, focusing on well-known feature films and major adaptations.

## Classic / Early Sherlock Holmes Films
- **Sherlock Holmes Baffled** — 1900
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1921
- **Sherlock Holmes** — 1922
- **The Return of Sherlock Holmes** — 1929
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1939  
  - Basil Rathbone as Sherlock Holmes
- **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes** — 1939  
  - Basil Rathbone

## Basil Rathbone Sherlock Holmes Films
- **Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror** — 1942
- **Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon** — 1942
- **Sherlock Holmes in Washington** — 1943
- **Sherlock Holmes Faces Death** — 1943
- **The Spider Woman** — 1943
- **The Scarlet Claw** — 1944
- **The Pearl of Death** — 1944
- **The House of Fear** — 1945
- **The Woman in Green** — 1945
- **Pursuit to Algiers** — 1945
- **Terror by Night** — 1946
- **Dressed to Kill** — 1946

## Notable Later Films
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1959  
  - Peter Cushing as Sherlock Holmes
- **A Study in Terror** — 1965
- **The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes** — 1970
- **The Seven-Per-Cent Solution** — 1976
- **Murder by Decree** — 1979
- **Young Sherlock Holmes** — 1985
- **Without a Clue** — 1988  
  - Comedy version with Michael Caine and Ben Kingsley

## Modern Sherlock Holmes Movies
- **Sherlock Holmes** — 2009  
  - Robert Downey Jr. as Sherlock Holmes  
  - Jude Law as Dr. Watson
- **Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows** — 2011  
  - Sequel to the 2009 film
- **Mr. Holmes** — 2015  
  - Ian McKellen as an elderly Sherlock Holmes

## Related / Spin-off Films
- **The Great Mouse Detective** — 1986  
  - Disney animated film inspired by Sherlock Holmes
- **Enola Holmes** — 2020  
  - Focuses on Sherlock’s sister
- **Enola Holmes 2** — 2022

## Popular TV Movie / Series Adaptations
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1983  
  - Ian Richardson
- **The Sign of Four** — 1983  
  - Ian Richardson
- **Sherlock Holmes and the Case of the Silk Stocking** — 2004
- **Sherlock: The Abominable Bride** — 2016  
  - Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman
